cold_open: Six division games, six finals, and one very expensive quarterback decision: Kevin O'Boyle started Kyler Murray, got −1.19 for it, and lost to Swanson by 6.97 with Tyler Shough's 20.60 on the bench.

notes.Kevin O'Boyle|Kevin Swanson: The luckiest win of the week: Swanson's 77.88 was only the ninth-best score in the league. O'Boyle's best possible lineup scored 108.95. The series now stands 24–19, Swanson.
notes.Brian Clark|Thomas: Tom had taken three straight. Clark hadn't beaten him since 2024 — until this week, by 29.03, with Brock Purdy's 21.55 never leaving his bench.
notes.Fadi|Steve Swanson: Fadi set the best lineup in the league — 96.9 percent of his best possible — and still lost by 16.65. Steve beat his projection by 35.62 and has won four straight.
notes.Dominic|Jeff: Dominic scored 100.35, the third-best total of the week, and lost anyway. Jeff's 115.38 topped the league, made it three straight, and put him ahead 8–7.
notes.Douglas|Evan: Last year's meeting came down to a field goal's worth of points. This one was the week's biggest blowout, 98.73–56.77, and Evan takes a 9–8 lead in the series.
notes.Eric|Shawn: Eric's Caleb Williams and Jalen Coker were the quarterback and receiver of the week. Shawn left just 2.92 points on his bench, and it didn't matter. Series even, 3–3.

awards.worst_managed: Jayden Daniels scored 16.83 on the bench. Bo Nix started and scored 4.72.

kicker: All six were division games. The rematches come in Week 14.
